decisions.reason: It is tightly connected to the firm's core recycling-system capabilities and the strong documented customer savings give management a clear basis to learn from and improve rather than withdraw it.
As a flagship modular plant line that fits the firm's strategic direction and existing knowledge base, it is more likely to receive further development resources than be removed.

The trommel screen remains close enough to the established portfolio for the firm to support it effectively, but its weaker visible market signal makes it somewhat more vulnerable than the modular plant concepts.

Although the firm recently withdrew an earlier slow-speed shredder, this broader new shredder line suggests it has absorbed those lessons and can use its R&D and service capabilities to refine the offer, albeit with elevated risk.
The spiral shaft screens build on the firm's existing screening and mobile processing know-how, and the firm's internal R&D and research links make continued adaptation more likely than withdrawal.
